In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have defined all the structure functions of the nucleon in terms of the parton distributions of quarks and gluons.
the nucleon structure in the deep-inelastic scattering of electroweak bosons is completely understood within the standard model.
the nucleon structure in the standard model is fully determined by the twist-four parton distribution functions, which are the only unknowns.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have provided a unified framework for the nucleon structure function calculations.

all nucleon structure functions are determined in the standard model by the twist-two parton distribution functions and their higher-twist corrections, and that the latter are determined by twist-three and twist-four partons.

the standard model of electroweak interactions is consistent with the partonic description of nucleons.
